text:
incident-bot: PAGER: spike in 503/504 on gateway /v1/generate -> 1min avg error rate 4.2% (threshold 0.5%). Severity: Pager. Sample correlation id: corr=3f7a1b2c
oncall-ali: Oncall here. Acknowledging. Paging SRE.
sre-maya: Joining. Which regions? Any customer impact?
incident-bot: Metrics: eu-west-1 and us-west-2; 90% of errors originate from gateway->runtime path; increased upstream 502/timeout between gateway and model-runtime.
runtime-jordan: Seeing a flurry of upstream retries in runtime logs. Possibly retry amplification from client side. Sharing kvlog segment.
eng-kai: kvlog link: s3://redwood-incident-drop/3120001111/kvlog-0.gz
support-lina: Support: ~12 customers reported degraded responses in last 10m, mostly high-traffic PLG tenants. Notifying impacted accounts.
oncall-ali: Mitigation: increasing gateway worker count by 2 in affected zones, disabling client-side aggressive retries via feature-flag 'retry-experiment'.
eng-kai: Done disabling flag in us-west-2. Confirmed: `retry-experiment=false`.
runtime-jordan: Collecting correlation ids. Sampled IDs: 3f7a1b2c, 9d4f2e10, a7c5b3ff. Grep: `zgrep "3f7a1b2c" kvlog-0.gz | head`.
sre-maya: Hypotheses: H1: client retries + gateway timeout threshold causing queue amplification. H2: degraded model-runtime pod causing slow responses -> upstream timeouts -> gateway 502/504.
eng-kai: Timeline: 17:02 traffic spike from tenant X, 17:03 retry flag rollout ramped up, 17:05 gateway worker saturation begins, 17:09 503 spike. Attaching timeline artifact.
oncall-ali: Mitigation update: scaling gateway + reduced retries appears to have halved 503 rate. Current error rate 2.1% (was 4.2%).
runtime-jordan: Runtime logs show model-serving queue length jumped. Some pods at CPU 95%. Scaling runtime pool by 3.
eng-kai: Started scale of runtime pool. New pods coming healthy.
support-lina: Customer impact: sending note to 12 customers, advising degraded performance and mitigation steps. No P0s so far.
pm-rajesh: Any rollback needed for recent traffic shaping change? We rolled out retry-experiment last night.
oncall-ali: Rollback queued if error rate >3% sustained for 10m. For now we left it disabled.
eng-kai: Dropping logs: https://dropbox.redwood/3120001111/logs.tar.gz
sre-maya: Next steps: assemble timeline, gather kvlog segments, correlate corr ids to traces, run post-mortem. Owners: timeline=eng-kai, tracing=runtime-jordan, customer-comms=support-lina.
oncall-ali: :thumbsup: Will keep this channel for live updates. If anything escalates, call pager.
